hypothesis: Finite-precision subtraction of large cumulative decay logs loses an intervening decay in the specified short canary; interval products preserve the sequential core result while retaining the same equations.
primary_comparator: Frozen sequential kron_recurrent on identical synthetic core inputs; source direct/factored paths are explicit controls.
primary_metric: Frozen elementwise allclose gates for outputs/state, gradients, optimizer mechanics and causal/reset/streaming behavior.
minimum_useful_effect: Identify or reject the specified rounded-prefix loss mechanism and retain separate core/model qualification gates.
success_rule: Interval-product unscaled core passes frozen output/state/gradient/optimizer mechanics tolerances on every declared core case. Source failures, candidate failures and all secondary scaling arms are retained. A model-row gate is reported separately and can fail without being hidden.
futility_rule: No tolerance relaxation; retain every failure; stop under frozen CPU/wall/disk/artifact/nonfinite rules.

authorization.approved_resources: Existing local CPU, one PyTorch/inter-op/BLAS thread; maximum 600 cumulative CPU seconds and 900 cumulative execution wall seconds across all numerical attempts, excluding dependency download/install.
authorization.max_walltime: 900 cumulative numerical execution seconds, excluding dependency download/install; entire session research stops 12:04 UTC.
authorization.local_cpu_budget: 600 cumulative numerical CPU seconds across attempts. Installation CPU reported separately.

design.mechanism_equations: Same preserved recurrence and 1e-18 norm floor; replace rounded-prefix log subtraction with interval products only in named variants; scaling is a separate factor.
design.control_rationale: Interval vs prefix and scaled vs unscaled are separated. Primary contrast is interval_direct vs source_direct; combined changes are secondary.
design.seed_selection_method: Prepared protocol fixed seeds; no seeded task picker exists.
design.matching_track: E01 numerical fidelity; one explicitly approved canary
design.compute_accounting: All numerical attempts cumulative, one Torch/inter-op/BLAS thread; install CPU and peak extra disk retained separately.

data.dataset_versions: Only synthetic tensors and random token IDs; no dataset or checkpoint bodies.

training.updates: One AdamW step per variant/reference pair in the one named model row, including separately labeled mixed-core control.
training.optimizer_schedule: Parent AdamW, LR0.001, epsilon1e-4; no language training.
training.precision: FP32/FP64 synthetic cores; FP32 model parameters/core, separate FP64-core control.

execution.runtime_versions: CPU-only torch==2.9.1+cpu cp313 x86_64 wheel and required dependencies in session-local venv.
execution.source_ownership_and_concurrent_writers: Parent owns new run/report and additive metadata. Parent sources remain unchanged. Shared baseline files are immutable.

fidelity_tolerances.policy: Use the frozen parent tolerances; no post-hoc relaxation. Capture finite failures and missing gradients.

canary_matrix.source: Hash-pinned parent model.py, common.py, qualify.py, protocol/addenda. No archived file modifications.
canary_matrix.reference: source sequential recurrence, same visible dtype and input tensors
canary_matrix.factorial_control: Interval vs prefix and scaled vs unscaled are separated. Primary contrast is interval_direct vs source_direct; combined changes are secondary.

tiny_core_cases.expected_two_token_zero_state: For first gate very negative: final=1/2+exp(-1)/4. Hypothesis: FP32 prefix controls give 3/4 at -2^27 while FP64 retains the increment; -2^56 tests the analogous FP64 limit.

random_core_cases.q_k_v: normalized seeded synthetic values; include zero and 1e-10-scaled value positions
random_core_cases.gates: nonpositive seeded gates and sigmoid beta/write
random_core_cases.reset_and_chunk_checks: nonzero state, before-token resets, irregular split, same-shape future intervention
random_core_cases.derivatives: all independent core input gradients under one fixed scalar probe

checks: one AdamW step and optimizer state
model_row.positive_control: Repeat the source factored/reference row with the archived FP64-core workaround, clearly labeled mixed precision.

cost_estimate.required_approval: Exact donor approval under AGENTS.md rule 3 before dependency installation or tensor/model execution.
cost_estimate.resources: Existing local CPU, one PyTorch/inter-op/BLAS thread; maximum 600 cumulative CPU seconds and 900 cumulative execution wall seconds across all numerical attempts, excluding dependency download/install.
cost_estimate.dependencies: Session-local virtual environment only, CPU-only torch==2.9.1+cpu and its required Python dependencies; no global install or GPU packages.
cost_estimate.dependency_size_evidence: Official cp313 x86_64 CPU wheel is 184380800 bytes, SHA256 39b3dff6d8fba240ae0d1bede4ca11c2531ae3b47329206512d99e17907ff74b. This is metadata/HEAD evidence, not a downloaded binary.
cost_estimate.additional_disk_cap: 1 GiB for environment, temporary wheel/install data and canary outputs together; stop if this cannot be met. No corpus or checkpoint downloads.
cost_estimate.artifact_cap: 50 MiB new result/diagnostic artifacts; no full checkpoints saved.
cost_estimate.synthetic_optimizer_steps: At most one AdamW step per candidate/reference pair in the one named model qualification row.

evaluation.primary_endpoint: All 50 interval_direct core cases; separately report every variant/model-row gate.
evaluation.duplicate_policy: Every prepared case/variant retained, including finite failure and incomplete attempts.
evaluation.uncertainty_method: Bounded deterministic mechanics check; no population/model-quality inference.
evaluation.multiple_comparison_policy: No selection by favorable variant/metric; retain every fixed contrast.

evidence.preservation_policy: Preserve approved draft, approval, every raw attempt/diagnostic, all controls and unmodified historical evidence. No accepted-result changes.

decision.reason: Explicit user approval received; exact prepared scope frozen before installation/execution.
decision.next_experiment: If mechanics pass, propose a separately approved wider fidelity/performance canary; do not launch training from this result.
